questions.prompt: As of 2025, what percentage of children worldwide received at least one dose of measles-containing vaccine by their first birthday?
questions.insight: Coverage has plateaued short of the roughly 95% needed for herd immunity, a gap linked to recent measles outbreaks.

questions.prompt: Of all species that have been formally assessed on the IUCN Red List, what percentage are classified as threatened with extinction?

source.name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

questions.insight: Under 10% of the roughly 2 million known species have even been assessed, but among those evaluated, about 28% are threatened with extinction.

questions.prompt: How many airline passengers were carried on scheduled flights worldwide in 2024?
questions.insight: Global scheduled air travel surpassed pre-pandemic levels in 2024, up almost 8% from 2023.

questions.prompt: As of 2023, what was the world's annual population growth rate?
questions.insight: World population growth has slowed steadily from a peak of about 2.3% per year in the late 1960s to under 1% today.

questions.prompt: What share of global electricity generation came from wind and solar combined in 2024?
questions.insight: Wind and solar together overtook hydropower in 2024 to supply 15% of the world's electricity, after two decades of rapid growth.
